prompt: The evaluation repository asks the agent to "Apply embedding model expertise to this task". The fixture contains version/runtime ambiguity, a tempting shortcut, a compatibility edge case, and a failure path that distinguishes real expertise from generic completion. The acceptance boundary is embedding-systems: Define the semantic unit and downstream decision before selecting an embedding model. The adjacent fine-tuning-training discipline is a routing decoy unless its separate responsibility is actually requested. Resolve environment facts that change the answer, preserve existing contracts and user-owned state, and produce reproducible success plus failure or recovery evidence. A happy path alone is insufficient.

requirements: versioned provider behavior fixtures spanning legacy text-only and newer multimodal embedding models
labeled text-text and text-image pairs plus modality preprocessing manifests
candidate dimensions, task-instruction variants, vector norms and semantic-match thresholds
old/new cache/store schemas, coexistence traces, latency/cost and rollback fixtures
representative negative, interruption, compatibility, or recovery path

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The result must establish the actual embedding-systems boundary and relevant environment before acting, preserve the hierarchy relationship (broader=implementation; near-neighbor=fine-tuning-training), and not absorb the near-neighbor responsibility merely because it is adjacent.
Define the semantic unit and downstream decision before selecting an embedding model.
The result must make its consequential assumptions, ownership, and decision sequence explicit and reproducible.

Evaluate downstream retrieval/classification/clustering behavior on labeled cases, compare model revisions, test long/short/multilingual inputs and zero/degenerate vectors, and measure latency/storage cost.

The result must not take the tempting shortcut prohibited by this skill: Do not compare vectors from incompatible models, infer absolute meaning from similarity thresholds without calibration, or choose dimensions solely from benchmark headlines.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence (Provider/model/version/task/preprocessing/dimension/normalization representation identity; Input limit, truncation, batching/cache and degenerate-vector behavior; Labeled downstream similarity/retrieval/classification/clustering quality plus latency/cost evidence; Versioned migration/backfill/coverage/cutover/rollback and drift-canary evidence), with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty.
